newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Halliburton started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Halliburton started as buy.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said on Wednesday it started coverage of Halliburton Co with a buy rating, because it had become the best growth story in the firm's oilfield service.
-- Analyst Byron Dunn said in a research note his 1997 earnings estimate was $3.30 per share and his 1998 earnings estimate was $4.25 per share.
-- Dunn said his 12- to 18-month price target was $100 per share.

-- Oil and natural gas company Halliburton said on Tuesday it signed a definitive pact to acquire NUMAR Corp, which makes devices to evaluate underground rock formations in oil and gas wells, for almost $40 per share in stock.

-- "During 1999, we believe that Halliburton's expansion and development of acquired NUMAR technologies and systems will begin to have a material effect on the company's global wireline logging, directional drilling, reservoir exploitation software and integrated sevices market share, pricing and margins," Dunn said.
-- Halliburton's stock was up 3/8 at 81 while NUMAR's stock surged 17-1/4 to 38.
